pre_score_fix: Synthetic test exposed loss of B candidate cuts when equal model labels merged; C now retains B latent proposed intervals. V1 never scored.
source: IDSSE_DFL_source_complete; legal external consumed development matches; not blind validation
baseline: Frozen HC_M3 exact R12 full predictions; no new model fit
A: Set true D mask; fill removed false D with frozen conditional Home argmax; other HA unchanged
B: Within current predicted Alive intervals, use ONLY true direct HA boundaries and mean frozen Home for each segment. Removes old HA cuts; gives both time AND event count; direction not oracle.
C: Reassign each current predicted HA segment by true majority ownership; ties retain label; Dead unchanged. Frame-majority is not spell-optimal.
D: Overwrite complete true HA spells shorter than1s or5s; reveals existence,timing and direction. Not a deployable proposal.
factorial: All8 A/B/C combinations in A→B→C order; D_lt1,D_lt5 with/withoutA, total12. Noncommutative interactions reported, not additive upper bounds.
controls: baseline identity; full A+B+C must equal external truth; official-vs-ROI equivalence every arm
gate: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no candidate promotion possible from oracle scores. Rank engineering by mean gains and matched-loss interactions, not target GT.
resources: No downloads/training; public caches only; threads2; small compressed results; no sealed WOY/WR9
